steps.code:
# Fetch all pending payment requests (paginate) and also get balance and payment cards
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
all_pending = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status="pending", page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    # Check if response is a list or dict with error
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and "message" in resp:
        print("Error fetching requests:", resp)
        break
    all_pending.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total pending requests fetched:", len(all_pending))
# Filter for May 2023 (created_at month=5, year=2023)
may_requests = [r for r in all_pending if r["created_at"][:7] == "2023-05"]
print("Pending requests in May 2023:", len(may_requests))
for r in may_requests:
    print(r["payment_request_id"], r["amount"], r["description"], r["created_at"])

# Get balance
balance_resp = apis.venmo.show_venmo_balance(access_token=access_token)
print("Balance:", balance_resp)

# Get payment cards to confirm card ending 4184
cards = apis.venmo.show_payment_cards(access_token=access_token)
print("Cards:", cards)
